description: This file defines various identifier classes used in Spark SQL, including CatalystIdentifier trait, TableIdentifier, FunctionIdentifier, AliasIdentifier, and QualifiedTableName, with methods for string representation and handling database/table/function identifiers.

classes.name: CatalystIdentifier
classes.description: A sealed trait representing an identifier that may specify a database and catalog, with methods for string formatting and parts extraction.

classes.name: AliasIdentifier
classes.description: A case class encapsulating an alias name or identifier with a qualifier sequence, used for subquery aliasing.

classes.name: TableIdentifier
classes.description: A case class identifying a table with optional database and catalog, extending CatalystIdentifier.

classes.name: QualifiedTableName
classes.description: A class representing a fully qualified table name including catalog, database, and table name.

classes.name: FunctionIdentifier
classes.description: A case class identifying a function with optional database and catalog, extending CatalystIdentifier.

methods.name: quoteIdentifier
methods.description: Escapes back-ticks within an identifier name by doubling them.

methods.name: quotedString
methods.description: Returns the identifier as a quoted string, escaping back-ticks.

methods.name: unquotedString
methods.description: Returns the identifier as an unquoted string, including catalog and database if present.

methods.name: nameParts
methods.description: Returns the parts of the identifier as a sequence, including catalog and database if present.
